description:
Return one Eurorack manufacturer: its website, every module of theirs in the reference, and their maker-wide documents.

Use it for "what does <maker> make?" or to browse a maker's line before picking modules. For filtering (by function, jacks, HP) use search_modules with manufacturer instead.

Args:
  - manufacturer_id: the maker's id, e.g. "make-noise", "mutable-instruments", "alm-busy-circuits". A near-miss returns an error listing close ids.

Returns:
  - id, name, website (the maker's own site), url (their page on eurorackref.com)
  - module_count, modules[]: { id, name, manufacturer, hp, function_tags, production_status, url }, by name
  - sources[]: maker-wide documents not tied to one module (same shape as get_module's sources)
  - _meta.corpus_records: how many modules in the whole reference have a typed record
name: get_manufacturer
title: Look up a manufacturer
